decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on tightly linked to the firm's web-mapping base and supported by several quick releases, it is close to the core business and should be retained while its market performance is still being learned.

The hierarchical search plugin is a low-distance extension of the established offer, and in a growing industry a medium-sized R&D-active firm with a broad portfolio would usually keep such a product unless clear underperformance is visible.

The mobile map layer control component was prominently presented with a clear usability improvement claim, so it appears to meet strategic aspirations around mobile geospatial solutions and merits continued support.

A software platform for building GIS solutions fits the firm's long-term direction toward integrated enterprise geospatial solutions, so boundedly rational management would continue it despite early uncertainty.

Mobile field data capture software is close to the firm's established customer needs and complements its integration and mobile capabilities, making it sensible to keep while assessing adoption over more than one period.

The search extension for web map apps is a related modular product that can leverage existing resources and customer relationships, so with no strong evidence of failure the firm would keep it rather than redeploy resources immediately.
